entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-26
entry.content:
Issues

  • [Maui Blazor] Disable automatic package import when using the Razor SDK as it breaks Razor Class Libraries #33301
  • [Entry] Add `HasBorder` property #33300
  • [WinUI]Editor cursor renders as “dot” after clearing text when parent Border.StrokeThickness is changed dynamically #33298

Closed
